Quod vero monstrum inveniunt in misto, ut

page.notes: Dropped capital Q in "Quod" is a large woodcut-style initial, read as Q. The "ct" in "junƈta" and "pradicta" is a ligature (c-t). The title word read as "pradicta" is set with the ct ligature and is slightly unclear: [?] not added since the letters are plain. Small printer's marks in both margins, next to the heading and the first lines, are not readable as text and are not transcribed. The paragraph ends with "paula-" carried over to the next page.
